sources.entry: Sync-in - File storage, syncing, sharing, and collaboration with real-time editing, permission management, and desktop/CLI clients. (Demo, Source Code, Clients) AGPL-3.0 Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: Sync-in is a self-hosted platform for file storage, synchronization, sharing, and team collaboration, with online document editing and desktop/CLI clients.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a web interface with drag and drop, gallery view, sorting, filtering, and file previews. It supports authentication via local accounts, OIDC, LDAP, MFA, recovery codes, and application passwords. Organization features include spaces, shares, guests, personal groups, roles, and fine-grained permissions. Public links can be protected with passwords, access limits, and expiration dates. It offers online document editing through Collabora Online, OnlyOffice, Euro-Office, and draw.io, plus comments, notifications, file locking, activity tracking, full-text search with document content indexing, storage quotas, trash retention, and WebDAV access. Desktop and CLI clients for Windows, macOS, and Linux handle multi-server synchronization.
use_cases: sync files across devices with desktop client
public share links with passwords and expiry
how_to_run: Docker setup: see the Docker setup section of the documentation
NPM setup: see the NPM setup section of the documentation
notable: Keeps files readable on the regular filesystem rather than in a proprietary store
Integrates Collabora Online, OnlyOffice, Euro-Office, and draw.io for document editing
WebDAV support for file explorers, network drives, and mobile apps
Desktop and CLI clients with multi-server synchronization
caveats: Online editing depends on an external office suite (Collabora Online, OnlyOffice, or Euro-Office) being deployed alongside it
Sponsor and code-signing details in the README are not relevant to the software's capabilities
